Privacy Policy

This website does not set cookies, run analytics scripts, or track you. The logs our hosting provider keeps are the standard ones, and we do not look at them unless something breaks.

If you phone or email the front desk, the message stays on the front desk. We do not add you to a mailing list, because we do not have a mailing list.

If you buy a membership or punch card in person, we keep a paper record with your name and emergency contact, per our insurer, and that record never leaves the building.

Questions about this policy: ask at the front desk, or write to hello@peakformclimbing.example.
